name: Evil Transing
description: Under Psycho Enchantment, pets do not receive evil skill damage.

name: Ink Bloom
description: Under Psycho Enchantment, Reduce 1 PP of enemy's last used skill when pet's ability is rised.

name: Psyche Enforce
description: Under Psycho Enchantment, spirit skill costs double PP to increase a pet's attack by 10%

name: Psychic Overload
description: Under Psycho Enchantment, spirit skill cost double PP to first strike and critical strike.

name: Psycho Trample
description: Under Psycho Enchantment, spirit skill costs double PP to critical strike on shielded monsters.

name: Spirit Absorb
description: Under Psycho Enchantment, spirit skill costs double PP to heal 25% of skill damage.

name: Spirit Assimilate
description: Under Psycho Enchantment, spirit skill costs double PP to heal 50% of skill damage.

name: Spirit Control
description: Under Psycho Enchantment, spirit skill costs double PP to add 50% chance to stun the enemy for 1 turn.

name: Spirit Maniple
description: Under Psycho Enchantment, spirit skill costs double PP to add 25% chance to stun the enemy for 1 turn.

name: Spirit Piercing
description: Under Psycho Enchantment, spirit type skill costs double PP to ignore the shield.
